ipxact:component.ipxact:name: efx_csi2_rx
ipxact:component.ipxact:description: The MIPI D-PHY is a scalable physical layer for interfacing various components such as cameras and displays to host devices. The MIPI D-PHY Controller core allows you to control and configure the MIPI D-PHY interface. You use the MIPI D-PHY Controller core with the Titanium HSIO pins configured as MIPI lanes to build a custom MIPI interface.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: PACK_TYPE
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Enables the controller to pack different pixel data type. Only enable the pack type that you are using to save logic resources. 4’b0001: Pack 40 4’b0010: Pack 48 4’b0100: Pack 56 4’b1000: Pack 64 4’b0011: Pack 40 or 48 4’b0101: Pack 40 or 56 4’b1111: Pack all types (default) Pack 40 RAW10, RAW20, YUV_420_10, YUV_422_10. Pack 48 RAW6, RAW12, RAW24, RGB888, YUV_420_8_legacy. Pack 56 RAW7, RAW14, RAW28. Pack 64 RAW8, RAW16, RGB444, RGB565, RGB555, YUV_422_8, YUV_420_8, generic long packet, user define 8- bit, embedded 8-bit non image packet.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: tLPX_NS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Soft D-PHY timing parameter in ns. Values according to MIPI D-PHY specifications.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: tINIT_NS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Soft D-PHY timing parameter in ns. Values according to MIPI D-PHY specifications.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: tCLK_TERM_EN_NS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Soft D-PHY timing parameter in ns. Values according to MIPI D-PHY specifications.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: tD_TERM_EN_NS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Soft D-PHY timing parameter in ns. Values according to MIPI D-PHY specifications.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: tHS_SETTLE_NS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Soft D-PHY timing parameter in ns. Values according to MIPI D-PHY specifications.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: tHS_PREPARE_ZERO_NS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Values according to MIPI D-PHY specifications.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: NUM_DATA_LANE
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Number of data lanes

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: ASYNC_STAGE
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Number of asynchronous register stages

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: HS_BYTECLK_MHZ
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: MIPI parallel clock frequency in Mhz to support data rate of 80 Mbps to 1500 Mbps.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: CLOCK_FREQ_MHZ
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: IP core clock frequency in Mhz

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: DPHY_CLOCK_MODE
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: To enable discontinuous or continuous HS mode clock.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: PIXEL_FIFO_DEPTH
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: FIFO depth size that stores the pixel packet data.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: AREGISTER
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:displayName: Enable pipeline state for RXStopState signal
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: To enable pipeline stage for RXStopState signal. The pipeline registers are clocked with HS mode byte clock. Compensates the MIPI HSIO deserializer, read FIFO and data synchronizer latency in designs with low MIPI data rate.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: ENABLE_USER_DESKEWCAL
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:displayName: Enable user setting on RX data IO lane dynamic delay
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Allows you to control the RX data IO lane dynamic delay.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: Pack_40
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Enable Pack 40:RAW10, RAW20, YUV_420_10, YUV_422_10

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: Pack_48
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Enable Pack 48:RAW6, RAW12, RAW24, RGB888, YUV_420_8_legacy

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: Pack_56
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Enable Pack 56:RAW7, RAW14, RAW28

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: Pack_64
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Enable Pack 64:RAW8, RAW16, RGB444, RGB565, RGB555, YUV_422_8, YUV_420_8, generic long packet, user define 8- bit, embedded 8-bit non image packet

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: FRAME_MODE
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: To select generic mode or accurate mode

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: ENABLE_VCX
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:displayName: Enable extra bits on Virtual Channel
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: To support 16 virtual channel

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: MIPI_CSI2_RX_DEBUG
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: This option turns on some debug ports on the IP.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: MIPI_CSI2_RX_PIXEL_SIDEBAND
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: This option turns on additional pixel domain related ports on the IP.
